title: 安妮·风中的小披风
description: 红发小女孩安妮抱着提伯斯站在高大拱门前，儿童衣装与短披风被夕光勾边，表情坚定而天真。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Annie is a little girl with a short red bob, a dark headband with small pointed decorations, large curious eyes, and her brown teddy bear Tibbers. Preserve her child age and small natural child proportions, never an adult figure. Dress her in a modest long-sleeved purple dress, opaque tights, sturdy boots, and a short cape; Tibbers remains an ordinary plush bear.
art_direction.scene: She stands on a broad safe courtyard landing holding Tibbers against her chest, chin lifted toward a sunlit archway. Keep the pose confident but unmistakably childlike, with both boots grounded and no flames. Strong late light outlines her hair and cape; enormous simplified stone shapes and a distant tree create scale through bold wax-crayon planes rather than danger.
art_direction.palette: berry purple, ginger red, teddy brown, amber rim light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
